title: Top 10 Essential Places to Visit in Jammu and Kashmir - Complete Guide
summary: Discover the ultimate travel spots in Jammu and Kashmir, from historic structures to scenic natural hideaways that you simply cannot miss.
content: Exploring Jammu and Kashmir is like walking through a living history book. With its diverse terrain, colorful markets, and centuries-old culture, there's an adventure waiting at every corner. In this curated guide, we break down the top must-visit landmarks including Srinagar Dal Lake, Gulmarg Gondola, Pahalgam Betaab Valley, and more, detailing the best routes, local guides, and timing details to ensure your travel diary is packed with highlights.
